quotes.text: # $date (String) - The date/time the filter was applied.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The filter-log-match-summary date argument comes from aMsgHdr->GetDate and is formatted in local time. Its Fluent comment says the time the filter was applied, which does not match the producer. The later log sink adds a separate current timestamp. Keep the message date and log timestamp distinct when documenting or reviewing this interface.
title: Filter log summary dates come from the message header
